clearance_review: Selected frame and rectangular leaf have the same measured jamb profile (0.8970 m outer width), slab width (0.7558 m), height (1.8060 m) and thickness (0.0857 m) as the accepted same-author PSX family; the nominal slab overlaps the inner jamb. A 1.3% uniform Panel/Handle fit, centered at the measured leaf width center, inferred hinge-side depth and leaf height center, retains the paneled geometry while giving operating clearance. The measured leaf/frame center offset (1.87 mm) is removed after fitting. Verify the swept stop and contact on this individual source; no collision is disabled. The first normalization used x=0.016818 m from the older pack, but this source has a different depth offset: the pivot fell inside the slab and the sweep hit the jamb after 11 degrees. The corrected x=0.043473 m is measured from this leaf front face.
modifications: Select the original Wooden_Door_007 single-leaf assembly with matching source frame and retain the original 4K CC BY atlas.
Apply uniform 1.015 full-assembly scale and proper Y-up to Z-up rotation; recenter on this source frame opening, with no reflection.
Infer a left-side revolute axis opposite the source handle on this leaf opening face (x=0.043473 m after overall scaling); no modeled hinge hardware or manufacturer pivot is claimed.
Apply 1.3% uniform Panel/Handle clearance fit about this leaf center; measured post-fit width 0.7571 m and height 1.8093 m. The original frame is unaltered.
Partition the intact U-frame at measured jamb/header profile boundaries; retain all frame, leaf and both-side handle collisions.
Start closed and already unlatched. No separate projecting latch/lock bolt is modeled; no collision exclusion is needed.
